acceptance.statement: Catalog declares one existing owner contract for each canonical loop with accurate controller implementation status and owner domain bindings.
Unobserved or worker-degraded loops cannot be accepted live: stale heartbeats, future heartbeats, missing observations, or archive-only evidence fail closed with explicit rejection reasons.

Worker functional health overrides process readyz: downstream HTTP 200 responses with degraded/unready payload bodies fail closed in both the downstream health prober and loop inventory health projection.

actual_state: BFF loop inventory and health read models (services/control-plane/bff/loop_inventory.py)

proof: Implemented controller contracts in loop-catalog.registry.json declare complete idempotency_key and duplicate_event_policy configurations.
Read models deduplicate health and inventory items by loop_id, tenant_id, and environment.

test_downstream_health_probe_fails_when_worker_reports_unready and test_downstream_health_probe_fails_when_worker_reports_degraded_status verify that HTTP 200 with degraded JSON payload fails closed with a functional failure reason.

test_loop_health_read_model_rejects_record_with_degraded_worker_health verifies that worker functional degradation sets current_record_accepted to False and rejection_reason to 'worker functional health is degraded despite process readiness'.
test_unobserved_loops_project_as_unobserved_and_not_live verifies that implemented loops without active runtime records project as unobserved and cannot claim live truth.
Each projected loop reports controller contract coverage and declaration via GET /bff/v5/loop-inventory.
GET /bff/v5/loop-health exposes detailed evidence packet, highest truth level, and operator truth provenance for each loop.
Implemented loop catalog entries define restart_behavior specifying how each controller restores state from durable stores upon restart.
Downstream health monitor maintains SQLite WAL persistence for incidents and outbox deliveries across restarts.
All changes preserve backward compatibility for BFF read models and registry loaders.
Contract tests in test_loop_inventory_read_model_contract.py and test_loop_health_read_model_contract.py pass completely.
